quote: Higher baseline IL-6 before challenge (not statistically significant) suggested immune priming, while lower post-challenge IL-6 and elevated IL-10 indicated a controlled, non-excessive inflammatory response that limits tissue damage without compromising pathogen clearance (Jiang Y. H. et al., 2024).
statement: 挑战前较高的基线IL-6暗示免疫启动，而挑战后较低的IL-6和升高的IL-10表明一种受控的、非过度的炎症反应，这种反应限制组织损伤而不损害病原体清除。
text_zh: 挑战前较高的基线IL-6暗示免疫启动，而挑战后较低的IL-6和升高的IL-10表明一种受控的、非过度的炎症反应，这种反应限制组织损伤而不损害病原体清除。
text_en: Higher baseline IL-6 before challenge suggests immune priming, while lower IL-6 and elevated IL-10 after challenge indicate a controlled, non-excessive inflammatory response that limits tissue damage without compromising pathogen clearance.
limitations: 基线IL-6差异无统计学显著性

quote: Elevated IgM was consistent with enhanced humoral immunity, and the combination of higher SOD and lower MDA indicated reduced oxidative stress.
statement: IgM升高与体液免疫增强一致，SOD升高和MDA降低的组合表明氧化应激减少。
text_zh: IgM升高与体液免疫增强一致，SOD升高和MDA降低的组合表明氧化应激减少。
text_en: The increase in IgM is consistent with enhanced humoral immunity, and the combination of increased SOD and decreased MDA indicates reduced oxidative stress.

quote: Such a low-inflammation, high-antioxidant status favors energy allocation to growth over immune-mediated catabolism (Amoah et al., 2019).
statement: 这种低炎症、高抗氧化状态有利于将能量分配给生长而非免疫介导的分解代谢。
text_zh: 这种低炎症、高抗氧化状态有利于将能量分配给生长而非免疫介导的分解代谢。
text_en: This low-inflammatory, high-antioxidant state favors the allocation of energy to growth rather than immune-mediated catabolism.

quote: Improved growth performance (Figures 3A , B) was consistent with enhanced digestive activity (higher trypsin), expanded absorptive area, and reduced metabolic cost of inflammation.
statement: 生长性能的提高与消化活性增强（胰蛋白酶升高）、吸收面积扩大以及炎症代谢成本降低相一致。
text_zh: 生长性能的提高与消化活性增强（胰蛋白酶升高）、吸收面积扩大以及炎症代谢成本降低相一致。
text_en: The improvement in growth performance is consistent with enhanced digestive activity (increased trypsin), expanded absorption area, and reduced inflammatory metabolic costs.

quote: Previous studies have linked improved growth with probiotic modulation of the GH/IGF-1 axis (Mahfuj et al., 2026).
statement: 先前的研究已将生长改善与益生菌对GH/IGF-1轴的调节联系起来。
text_zh: 先前的研究已将生长改善与益生菌对GH/IGF-1轴的调节联系起来。
text_en: Previous studies have linked growth improvement to the regulation of the GH/IGF-1 axis by probiotics.

quote: The collected fish (n > 30 at each sample site) were clinically examined in situ to identify any potential alterations or lesions.
statement: 采集的鱼（每个采样点超过30条）进行了现场临床检查，以识别任何潜在的改变或病变。
text_zh: 采集的鱼（每个采样点超过30条）进行了现场临床检查，以识别任何潜在的改变或病变。
text_en: Collected fish (more than 30 per sampling site) underwent on-site clinical examination to identify any potential alterations or lesions.

quote: Hence, it is imperative to evaluate the resistance potential of this opportunistic pathogen worldwide in order to help farmers and veterinarians to establish more efficient and suitable chemical management practices for farm operations.
statement: 评估这种机会性病原体的全球耐药潜力对于帮助农民和兽医建立更有效、更合适的农场运营化学管理实践至关重要。
text_zh: 评估这种机会性病原体的全球耐药潜力对于帮助农民和兽医建立更有效、更合适的农场运营化学管理实践至关重要。
text_en: Assessing the global resistance potential of this opportunistic pathogen is crucial to help farmers and veterinarians establish more effective and appropriate chemical management practices for farm operations.

quote: The total prevalence (P) of fish with external abnormalities amounts to 14.04%.
statement: 鱼类外部异常的总体患病率为14.04%。
text_zh: 鱼类外部异常的总体患病率为14.04%。
text_en: The overall prevalence of external abnormalities in fish was 14.04%.

quote: It is important to note that water and habitat quality were found to be subpar during these specific months and at the mentioned stations.
statement: 在特定月份和站点，水质和栖息地质量被发现较差。
text_zh: 在特定月份和站点，水质和栖息地质量被发现较差。
text_en: At specific months and sites, water quality and habitat quality were found to be poor.

quote: Three metals (cobalt, copper, and cadmium) were selected for the metal resistance assay based on their projected toxicities and presence in water samples.
statement: 基于预期毒性和在水样中的存在，选择了三种金属（钴、铜和镉）进行金属耐受性测定。
text_zh: 基于预期毒性和在水样中的存在，选择了三种金属（钴、铜和镉）进行金属耐受性测定。
text_en: Based on expected toxicity and presence in water samples, three metals (cobalt, copper, and cadmium) were selected for metal tolerance assays.
outcome: 病原菌对环境的适应性/毒性潜力

quote: A clinical macroscopic analysis of C. carassius revealed various clinical indications, including hemorrhages, erosions, and necrosis.
statement: 对C. carassius进行的临床宏观分析揭示了多种临床指征，包括出血、侵蚀和坏死。
text_zh: 对C. carassius进行的临床宏观分析揭示了多种临床指征，包括出血、侵蚀和坏死。
text_en: Clinical macroscopic analysis of C. carassius revealed multiple clinical signs, including hemorrhage, erosion, and necrosis.

quote: Adding Bdellovibrio to aquaculture water reduces culturable bacteria, improves survival after A. hydrophila challenge, and decreases Enterobacterales abundance (Zhang et al., 2023).
statement: 在水产养殖水中添加Bdellovibrio可减少可培养细菌，提高嗜水气单胞菌攻击后的存活率，并降低肠杆菌目丰度。
text_zh: 在水产养殖水中添加Bdellovibrio可减少可培养细菌，提高嗜水气单胞菌攻击后的存活率，并降低肠杆菌目丰度。
text_en: Adding Bdellovibrio to aquaculture water reduces culturable bacteria, improves survival rate after Aeromonas hydrophila attack, and decreases the abundance of Enterobacterales.

quote: Since Bdellovibrio was absent from the control diet and not deliberately added, its enrichment in XS suggests that W. cibaria XN-2a creates a favorable niche for this complementary biocontrol agent, thereby enhancing host resistance.
statement: 由于对照饲料中不存在且未故意添加Bdellovibrio，其在XS组中的富集表明W. cibaria XN-2a为这种互补的生物防治剂创造了有利生态位，从而增强了宿主抵抗力。
text_zh: 由于对照饲料中不存在且未故意添加Bdellovibrio，其在XS组中的富集表明W. cibaria XN-2a为这种互补的生物防治剂创造了有利生态位，从而增强了宿主抵抗力。
text_en: Since Bdellovibrio was absent from the control diet and not intentionally added, its enrichment in the XS group indicates that W. cibaria XN-2a created a favorable ecological niche for this complementary biocontrol agent, thereby enhancing host resistance.

quote: Importantly, the preservation of overall alpha diversity together with this beneficial compositional shift strongly supports the safety and efficacy of this BLIS-producing strain as a feed additive.
statement: 整体α多样性的保留以及这种有益的组成转变有力地支持了该产生细菌素（BLIS）菌株作为饲料添加剂的安全性和有效性。
text_zh: 整体α多样性的保留以及这种有益的组成转变有力地支持了该产生细菌素（BLIS）菌株作为饲料添加剂的安全性和有效性。
text_en: The retention of overall alpha diversity and this beneficial compositional shift strongly support the safety and efficacy of this bacteriocin-producing (BLIS) strain as a feed additive.

quote: However, this species remains vulnerable to bacterial infections (Shuvho et al., 2016).
statement: 然而，该物种仍然容易受到细菌感染。
text_zh: 然而，该物种仍然容易受到细菌感染。
text_en: However, this species remains susceptible to bacterial infections.

quote: Aeromonas have been identified as significant pathogens responsible for numerous disease outbreaks in finfish farming worldwide (Lee and Wendy, 2017).
statement: 气单胞菌属已被确定为导致全球鳍鱼养殖中众多疾病爆发的主要病原体。
text_zh: 气单胞菌属已被确定为导致全球鳍鱼养殖中众多疾病爆发的主要病原体。
text_en: Aeromonas has been identified as a major pathogen causing numerous disease outbreaks in finfish aquaculture worldwide.

quote: This bacterium is responsible for causing hemorrhagic septicemia, skin ulcerations, and gastrointestinal tract infections in various fish hosts, including crucian carp (Jiang et al., 2020; Lü et al., 2016).
statement: 这种细菌会导致包括鲫鱼在内的多种鱼类宿主发生出血性败血症、皮肤溃疡和胃肠道感染。
text_zh: 这种细菌会导致包括鲫鱼在内的多种鱼类宿主发生出血性败血症、皮肤溃疡和胃肠道感染。
text_en: This bacterium causes hemorrhagic septicemia, skin ulcers, and gastrointestinal infections in multiple fish hosts, including crucian carp.

quote: These properties, together with the improved growth performance, enhanced immune parameters, and better intestinal morphology documented in the probiotic-fed crucian carp, support W. cibaria XN-2a as a promising probiotic candidate for sustainable aquaculture.
statement: 这些特性以及益生菌喂养的鲫鱼中记录的改善的生长性能、增强的免疫参数和更好的肠道形态，支持W. cibaria XN-2a作为可持续水产养殖中有前景的益生菌候选者。
text_zh: 这些特性以及益生菌喂养的鲫鱼中记录的改善的生长性能、增强的免疫参数和更好的肠道形态，支持W. cibaria XN-2a作为可持续水产养殖中有前景的益生菌候选者。
text_en: These characteristics, along with the improved growth performance, enhanced immune parameters, and better intestinal morphology recorded in crucian carp fed probiotics, support W. cibaria XN-2a as a promising probiotic candidate for sustainable aquaculture.

quote:
Clinical
macroscopic examination of the fish was also carried out. More than 14% of
the examined fishes showed the characteristic clinical signs.
statement: 对鱼进行了临床宏观检查，超过14%的被检鱼表现出特征性的临床症状。
text_zh: 对鱼进行了临床宏观检查，超过14%的被检鱼表现出特征性的临床症状。
text_en: Clinical macroscopic examination was performed on fish, and more than 14% of the examined fish showed characteristic clinical symptoms.

quote:
Drug screening
showed high levels of resistance to β-lactam antibiotics, 100% of the strains
were resistant to ampicillin followed by cefalotin (91.53%) and ticarcillin
(88.14%).
statement: 药物筛选显示菌株对β-内酰胺类抗生素具有高水平的耐药性，100%的菌株对氨苄西林耐药，其次是头孢噻吩（91.53%）和羧苄西林（88.14%）。
text_zh: 药物筛选显示菌株对β-内酰胺类抗生素具有高水平的耐药性，100%的菌株对氨苄西林耐药，其次是头孢噻吩（91.53%）和羧苄西林（88.14%）。
text_en: Drug screening showed that the strains had high-level resistance to β-lactam antibiotics, with 100% of the strains resistant to ampicillin, followed by cephalothin (91.53%) and carbenicillin (88.14%).
counterevidence: 高耐药率表明这些抗生素可能无效

quote:
More than 40% of the strains exhibited resistance against gentamicin,
amikacin and chloramphenicol.
statement: 超过40%的菌株对庆大霉素、阿米卡星和氯霉素表现出耐药性。
text_zh: 超过40%的菌株对庆大霉素、阿米卡星和氯霉素表现出耐药性。
text_en: More than 40% of the strains showed resistance to gentamicin, amikacin, and chloramphenicol.
intervention_record: 庆大霉素/阿米卡星/氯霉素
counterevidence: 部分菌株对这些抗生素耐药

quote:
These resistant profiles could be useful
information to avoid unnecessary use of chemical and antimicrobial products in
the aquatic environment and to provide a novel approach to manage bacterial
infection in fish.
statement: 这些耐药谱可以作为避免在水生环境中不必要地使用化学品和抗菌产品的有用信息，并为管理鱼类细菌感染提供一种新方法。
text_zh: 这些耐药谱可以作为避免在水生环境中不必要地使用化学品和抗菌产品的有用信息，并为管理鱼类细菌感染提供一种新方法。
text_en: These resistance profiles can serve as useful information to avoid the unnecessary use of chemicals and antimicrobial products in aquatic environments, and provide a new approach for managing bacterial infections in fish.
intervention_record: 基于药敏的抗菌药管理

quote: Dietary W. cibaria XN-2a may reach and transiently persist in the distal intestine and produces a BLIS (supported by in vitro activity), which may suppress certain pathogenic or competing bacteria.
statement: 日粮中的W. cibaria XN-2a可能到达并短暂存在于后肠中，产生细菌素（BLIS），从而抑制某些致病或竞争性细菌。
text_zh: 日粮中的W. cibaria XN-2a可能到达并短暂存在于后肠中，产生细菌素（BLIS），从而抑制某些致病或竞争性细菌。
text_en: W. cibaria XN-2a in the diet may reach and transiently exist in the hindgut, producing bacteriocins (BLIS), thereby inhibiting certain pathogenic or competitive bacteria.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成与病原菌抑制
limitations: 体外活性支持，体内未确认；序列未经直接证明

quote: If higher butyrate levels are indeed generated (a point requiring direct quantification), this metabolite could contribute to the improved intestinal barrier (higher FH/FW, lower inter-fold distance) and the reduced post-challenge IL-6 observed in the XS group.
statement: 如果确实生成了更高水平的丁酸，该代谢物可能有助于改善肠道屏障（更高的FH/FW，更低的褶间距离）以及XS组观察到的攻毒后IL-6降低。
text_zh: 如果确实生成了更高水平的丁酸，该代谢物可能有助于改善肠道屏障（更高的FH/FW，更低的褶间距离）以及XS组观察到的攻毒后IL-6降低。
text_en: If higher levels of butyrate were indeed produced, this metabolite may have contributed to improved intestinal barrier function (higher FH/FW, lower intercrypt distance) and the post-challenge reduction in IL-6 observed in the XS group.
outcome: 肠道屏障完整性与炎症反应
limitations: 丁酸未直接测量；仅为条件性假设

quote: This study demonstrates the presence of dual antibiotic and metal-resistant Aeromonas hydrophila strains in fish and their aquatic environment, which have not been subjected to any aquaculture practices thus far.
statement: 本研究证实，在尚未经历任何水产养殖实践的鱼类及其水生环境中存在双重抗生素和金属耐药性的嗜水气单胞菌菌株。
text_zh: 本研究证实，在尚未经历任何水产养殖实践的鱼类及其水生环境中存在双重抗生素和金属耐药性的嗜水气单胞菌菌株。
text_en: This study confirmed the presence of Aeromonas hydrophila strains with dual antibiotic and metal resistance in fish that have not yet undergone any aquaculture practices and in their aquatic environment.

quote: microbiota differences are correlational and the lack of controls (heat-killed bacteria or a non-BLIS-producing mutant) prevents attributing effects solely to viable W. cibaria or its BLIS
statement: 微生物群差异具有相关性，且缺乏对照（热灭活细菌或不产生BLIS的突变体），因此无法将效果完全归因于活的W. cibaria或其BLIS。
text_zh: 微生物群差异具有相关性，且缺乏对照（热灭活细菌或不产生BLIS的突变体），因此无法将效果完全归因于活的W. cibaria或其BLIS。
text_en: Microbiome differences are correlated, and controls (heat-inactivated bacteria or mutants that do not produce BLIS) are lacking; therefore, the effects cannot be fully attributed to live W. cibaria or its BLIS.
limitations: lack of controls (heat-killed bacteria or a non-BLIS-producing mutant)

quote: immune and histological parameters were measured only at limited time points
statement: 免疫和组织学参数仅在有限的时间点进行了测量。
text_zh: 免疫和组织学参数仅在有限的时间点进行了测量。
text_en: Immune and histological parameters were measured only at limited time points.
limitations: measured only at limited time points

quote: dietary supplementation with W. cibaria XN-2a was associated with significantly improved growth performance, feed efficiency, immune function and intestinal health of crucian carp
statement: 日粮补充W. cibaria XN-2a与鲫鱼生长性能、饲料效率、免疫功能和肠道健康的显著改善相关。
text_zh: 日粮补充W. cibaria XN-2a与鲫鱼生长性能、饲料效率、免疫功能和肠道健康的显著改善相关。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with W. cibaria XN-2a is associated with significant improvements in growth performance, feed efficiency, immune function, and gut health of crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料效率、免疫功能、肠道健康

quote: provided moderate (50%) protection against A. hydrophila challenge
statement: 对嗜水气单胞菌攻击提供了中等（50%）的保护。
text_zh: 对嗜水气单胞菌攻击提供了中等（50%）的保护。
text_en: Provided moderate (50%) protection against Aeromonas hydrophila challenge.

quote: The probiotic did not increase the overall antibiotic resistance burden
statement: 益生菌没有增加整体抗生素耐药负担。
text_zh: 益生菌没有增加整体抗生素耐药负担。
text_en: Probiotics did not increase the overall antibiotic resistance burden.

quote: was associated with a selective reduction of pathogen-associated virulence factors
statement: 与病原体相关毒力因子的选择性减少有关。
text_zh: 与病原体相关毒力因子的选择性减少有关。
text_en: Related to a selective reduction in pathogen-associated virulence factors.

quote: Metagenomic analysis revealed differences in the butanoate metabolism pathway and CAZy profiles between the control and probiotic-fed groups
statement: 宏基因组分析显示对照组和益生菌喂养组之间在丁酸盐代谢途径和CAZy谱方面存在差异。
text_zh: 宏基因组分析显示对照组和益生菌喂养组之间在丁酸盐代谢途径和CAZy谱方面存在差异。
text_en: Metagenomic analysis showed differences in butyrate metabolic pathways and CAZy profiles between the control group and the probiotic-fed group.

quote: which suggest an increased potential for butyrate synthesis and antibacterial/antioxidant activities
statement: 这表明丁酸盐合成以及抗菌/抗氧化活动的潜力增加。
text_zh: 这表明丁酸盐合成以及抗菌/抗氧化活动的潜力增加。
text_en: This indicates an increased potential for butyrate synthesis and antibacterial/antioxidant activity.
outcome: 代谢产物与抗氧化能力

quote: This caused an outbreak of a copepod parasite on crusian carp, Carassius auratus C.
statement: 干旱导致湖水盐度升高，进而引发了鲫鱼（Carassius auratus）身上桡足类寄生虫的爆发。
text_zh: 干旱导致湖水盐度升高，进而引发了鲫鱼（Carassius auratus）身上桡足类寄生虫的爆发。
text_en: Drought led to increased lake salinity, which in turn triggered an outbreak of copepod parasites on crucian carp (Carassius auratus).

quote: From this, it is evident that an ascent of chlorinity owing to the drought made this parasite possible to invade Lake Shinji from sea and to infest on a new host, C. auratus, and that exhaustion of the host fish through hypertonic condition make the damage serious.
statement: 干旱引起的盐度上升使寄生虫得以从海洋入侵湖泊并感染新宿主鲫鱼，且高渗条件导致的宿主鱼衰竭加剧了损害。
text_zh: 干旱引起的盐度上升使寄生虫得以从海洋入侵湖泊并感染新宿主鲫鱼，且高渗条件导致的宿主鱼衰竭加剧了损害。
text_en: Rising salinity caused by drought allowed parasites to invade lakes from the ocean and infect new host crucian carp, and host fish exhaustion caused by hyperosmotic conditions exacerbated the damage.

quote: A. hydrophila strains from fish exhibited resistance from 3 to 7 antibiotics, while 75% of the strains from water showed resistance to 3 antibiotics (Fig. 2B).
statement: 来自鱼类的嗜水气单胞菌菌株对3至7种抗生素表现出耐药性，而75%来自水体的菌株对3种抗生素表现出耐药性。
text_zh: 来自鱼类的嗜水气单胞菌菌株对3至7种抗生素表现出耐药性，而75%来自水体的菌株对3种抗生素表现出耐药性。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila strains from fish showed resistance to 3 to 7 antibiotics, while 75% of strains from water showed resistance to 3 antibiotics.

quote: The MAR index ranged from 0.23 to 0.54.
statement: 多重抗生素耐药指数（MAR）范围为0.23至0.54。
text_zh: 多重抗生素耐药指数（MAR）范围为0.23至0.54。
text_en: The multiple antibiotic resistance index (MAR) ranged from 0.23 to 0.54.

quote: Hasil penelitian yang dilakukan di Desa Karang Rejo, Desa Ploso Kandang dan Desa Wajak hanya ditemukan satu spesies saja, yaitu Lernaea cyprinacea.
statement: Hanya satu spesies Lernaea, yaitu Lernaea cyprinacea, yang ditemukan menyerang ikan maskoki di lokasi penelitian.
text_en: Hanya satu spesies Lernaea, yaitu Lernaea cyprinacea, yang ditemukan menyerang ikan maskoki di lokasi penelitian.

quote: Derajat infestasi dari serangan Lernaea cyprinacea di tiga desa tersebut tergolong dalam infestasi ringan.
statement: Tingkat serangan atau infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea pada ikan maskoki di ketiga desa tersebut dikategorikan sebagai infestasi ringan.
text_en: Tingkat serangan atau infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea pada ikan maskoki di ketiga desa tersebut dikategorikan sebagai infestasi ringan.

quote: However, Cao et al. (2022) have reported that A. hydrophila is recognized for its high pathogenicity to aquatic animals and is prevalent in diseased aquatic organisms worldwide, affecting a variety of fish species and the primary indications of A. hydrophila infection in fish consist of necrosis, ascetic fluid accumulation, darkening of the spleen and kidney, and liver pallor.
statement: Cao等人（2022）报告称，嗜水气单胞菌对水生动物具有高致病性，在全球患病水生生物中普遍存在，影响多种鱼类，其感染的主要迹象包括坏死、腹水积聚、脾脏和肾脏变黑以及肝脏苍白。
text_zh: Cao等人（2022）报告称，嗜水气单胞菌对水生动物具有高致病性，在全球患病水生生物中普遍存在，影响多种鱼类，其感染的主要迹象包括坏死、腹水积聚、脾脏和肾脏变黑以及肝脏苍白。
text_en: Cao et al. (2022) reported that Aeromonas hydrophila is highly pathogenic to aquatic animals, is prevalent in diseased aquatic organisms worldwide, affects multiple fish species, and its main signs of infection include necrosis, ascites accumulation, darkening of the spleen and kidneys, and pale liver.

quote: In the present study, approximately a thousand common carp were examined in Lake Tonga, revealing 153 pathological alterations, with 24.18% corresponding to hemorrhages and 75.82% to erosions and necroses of fins.
statement: 本研究检查了通加湖约一千条鲤鱼，发现153处病理改变，其中24.18%为出血，75.82%为鳍部侵蚀和坏死。
text_zh: 本研究检查了通加湖约一千条鲤鱼，发现153处病理改变，其中24.18%为出血，75.82%为鳍部侵蚀和坏死。
text_en: This study examined about one thousand carp in Lake Tonga and found 153 pathological changes, of which 24.18% were hemorrhages and 75.82% were fin erosion and necrosis.

quote: These alterations appear to be more common in fish inhabiting polluted environments, likely caused by a decline in bacteriological quality and chemical contamination of the surroundings.
statement: 这些病变在栖息于污染环境中的鱼类中更为常见，可能由周围环境的细菌学质量下降和化学污染引起。
text_zh: 这些病变在栖息于污染环境中的鱼类中更为常见，可能由周围环境的细菌学质量下降和化学污染引起。
text_en: These lesions are more common in fish inhabiting polluted environments, possibly caused by a decline in the bacteriological quality of the surrounding environment and chemical pollution.

quote: Various bacteria, including Aeromonas sp., are involved in causing lesions in freshwater fish, as shown by other studies (Lee and Wendy, 2017; Zhang et al., 2016).
statement: 包括气单胞菌属在内的各种细菌参与导致淡水鱼病变，其他研究已证实这一点。
text_zh: 包括气单胞菌属在内的各种细菌参与导致淡水鱼病变，其他研究已证实这一点。
text_en: Various bacteria, including the genus Aeromonas, are involved in causing lesions in freshwater fish; other studies have confirmed this.

quote: According to the 'Pathological code' methodology and integrated diagnoses, the health of fish in the Lake Tonga is considered precarious, with an overall prevalence of lesions well over 5%, indicating impaired habitat quality.
statement: 根据“病理编码”方法和综合诊断，通加湖鱼类的健康状况被认为岌岌可危，病变总体患病率远高于5%，表明栖息地质量受损。
text_zh: 根据“病理编码”方法和综合诊断，通加湖鱼类的健康状况被认为岌岌可危，病变总体患病率远高于5%，表明栖息地质量受损。
text_en: Based on the 'pathological code' methodology and comprehensive diagnosis, the health status of Tongjia Lake fish is considered precarious, with an overall lesion prevalence far exceeding 5%, indicating impaired habitat quality.

quote: Stations S3 and S1 exhibit the highest prevalence of affected fish, possibly due to the increased microbiological contamination of water in these sites (Liu et al., 2020).
statement: S3和S1监测站受影响鱼的患病率最高，可能是由于这些地点水体的微生物污染增加所致。
text_zh: S3和S1监测站受影响鱼的患病率最高，可能是由于这些地点水体的微生物污染增加所致。
text_en: The prevalence of disease in affected fish was highest at monitoring stations S3 and S1, possibly due to increased microbial contamination of the water bodies at these locations.

quote: In this study, A. hydrophila, which causing many disease outbreaks, were found in water and crucian carp captured from Lake Tonga.
statement: 在本研究中，从通加湖捕获的水体和鲫鱼中发现了嗜水气单胞菌，该菌常引起许多疾病爆发。
text_zh: 在本研究中，从通加湖捕获的水体和鲫鱼中发现了嗜水气单胞菌，该菌常引起许多疾病爆发。
text_en: In this study, Aeromonas hydrophila was found in water and crucian carp captured from Tongga Lake; this bacterium often causes many disease outbreaks.

quote: Ikan dapat dikatakan normal dan sehat apabila tidak terinfestasi Lernaea.
statement: Ikan dianggap normal dan sehat jika tidak mengalami infestasi Lernaea.
text_en: Ikan dianggap normal dan sehat jika tidak mengalami infestasi Lernaea.

quote: Positive correlations were observed between multidrug-resistant Aeromonas hydrophila (MAR >0.2) recovered from water and fish in Lake Tonga and high tolerance to all toxic metals (OR>1.0; 95% confidence interval).
statement: 在通加湖从水和鱼中分离出的多重耐药嗜水气单胞菌（MAR >0.2）与对所有有毒金属的高耐受性之间存在正相关关系。
text_zh: 在通加湖从水和鱼中分离出的多重耐药嗜水气单胞菌（MAR >0.2）与对所有有毒金属的高耐受性之间存在正相关关系。
text_en: There is a positive correlation between multidrug-resistant Aeromonas hydrophila (MAR >0.2) isolated from water and fish in Lake Tonga and high tolerance to all toxic metals.
outcome: 病原菌耐药性与金属耐受性的关联

quote: Fish, with their heightened sensitivity to environmental factors, serve as valuable bioindicators in monitoring programs, aiming to assess fish food quality, monitor water and aquatic environment quality, and evaluate the health status of fish populations (Outa et al., 2020).
statement: 鱼类对环境因素具有高度敏感性，可作为监测计划中有价值的生物指示剂，旨在评估鱼类饲料质量、监测水质和水生环境质量以及评估鱼类种群的健康状况。
text_zh: 鱼类对环境因素具有高度敏感性，可作为监测计划中有价值的生物指示剂，旨在评估鱼类饲料质量、监测水质和水生环境质量以及评估鱼类种群的健康状况。
text_en: Fish are highly sensitive to environmental factors and can serve as valuable bioindicators in monitoring programs, aimed at assessing fish feed quality, monitoring water quality and aquatic environmental quality, and evaluating the health status of fish populations.

quote: However, a significant difference (p<0.05) was observed in the prevalence of A. hydrophila among the various fish specimens.
statement: 然而，在不同鱼类样本中观察到了嗜水气单胞菌流行率的显著差异（p<0.05）。
text_zh: 然而，在不同鱼类样本中观察到了嗜水气单胞菌流行率的显著差异（p<0.05）。
text_en: However, significant differences in the prevalence of Aeromonas hydrophila were observed among different fish samples (p<0.05).

quote: All the strains showed the highest resistance rate for beta-lactam and ticarcillin.
statement: 所有菌株对β-内酰胺类和替卡西林表现出最高的耐药率。
text_zh: 所有菌株对β-内酰胺类和替卡西林表现出最高的耐药率。
text_en: All strains showed the highest resistance rates to beta-lactams and ticarcillin.

quote: More than 40 % of the strains were resistant to aminoside and chloramphenicol.
statement: 超过40%的菌株对氨基糖苷类和氯霉素具有耐药性。
text_zh: 超过40%的菌株对氨基糖苷类和氯霉素具有耐药性。
text_en: More than 40% of the strains are resistant to aminoglycosides and chloramphenicol.

quote: All isolates were found to be susceptible to imipinem, ciprofloxacin, nalidixic acid, nitrofurantoin, and fosfomycin.
statement: 所有分离株均被发现对亚胺培南、环丙沙星、萘啶酸、呋喃妥因和磷霉素敏感。
text_zh: 所有分离株均被发现对亚胺培南、环丙沙星、萘啶酸、呋喃妥因和磷霉素敏感。
text_en: All isolates were found to be susceptible to imipenem, ciprofloxacin, nalidixic acid, nitrofurantoin and fosfomycin.

quote: Penyakit dapat muncul di suatu perairan akibat ketidakseimbangan antara lingkungan, inang, dan patogen.
statement: Penyakit pada ikan dapat muncul akibat adanya ketidakseimbangan antara faktor lingkungan, inang, dan patogen.
text_en: Penyakit pada ikan dapat muncul akibat adanya ketidakseimbangan antara faktor lingkungan, inang, dan patogen.

quote: Ektoparasit ini dapat ditemukan pada seluruh permukaan tubuh, mulut dan insang ikan.
statement: Ektoparasit Lernaea dapat ditemukan di seluruh permukaan tubuh, mulut, dan insang ikan.
text_en: Ektoparasit Lernaea dapat ditemukan di seluruh permukaan tubuh, mulut, dan insang ikan.

quote: Lernaea dapat menyebabkan iritasi pada kulit serta lesi.
statement: Infestasi Lernaea dapat menyebabkan iritasi kulit dan lesi pada ikan.
text_en: Infestasi Lernaea dapat menyebabkan iritasi kulit dan lesi pada ikan.

quote: なかでも特に注目されたのはカワチブナ(Carassius auratus GUVlERI)にカリグスが寄生していたことと,塩分が高くなったために起きたと思われる体表の出血病変が多く観察されたことである｡
statement: カワチブナにカリグスが寄生しており、高塩分による体表の出血病変が多数観察された。
text_zh: カワチブナにカリグスが寄生しており、高塩分による体表の出血病変が多数観察された。
text_en: Carp were parasitized by sea lice, and numerous hemorrhagic skin lesions caused by high salinity were observed.
outcome: 寄生虫感染および体表病変

quote: カリグスの生存日数に及ぼす塩素量の影響に関する室内実験は,1973年9月14日から9月25日にかけて,カワチブナの体表から採集した大きさが約3mmから6mmのadult stageのものを用いて行なった｡
statement: カワチブナ体表から採集した成体カリグスを用い、生存日数に及ぼす塩素量の影響を室内実験で調査した。
text_zh: カワチブナ体表から採集した成体カリグスを用い、生存日数に及ぼす塩素量の影響を室内実験で調査した。
text_en: An indoor experiment was conducted to investigate the effect of chlorine levels on the survival days of adult Caligus collected from the body surface of Carassius auratus grandoculis.

quote: Lernaea dalam budida-ya selalu berhubungan dengan mortalitas yang tinggi (Kismiyati dkk., 2011)
statement: Infestasi Lernaea dalam budidaya selalu dikaitkan dengan tingkat kematian yang tinggi.
text_en: Infestasi Lernaea dalam budidaya selalu dikaitkan dengan tingkat kematian yang tinggi.

quote: akibat yang ditimbulkan bagi pembudidaya adalah kerugian yang besar apabila ikan yang dibudidaya mengalami kematian dalam jumlah yang besar.
statement: Kematian massal akibat penyakit menyebabkan kerugian ekonomi besar bagi pembudidaya.
text_en: Kematian massal akibat penyakit menyebabkan kerugian ekonomi besar bagi pembudidaya.

quote: Ikan maskoki (Carrassius auratus) merupakan salah satu jenis ikan hias air tawar tergolong dalam jenis ikan karper yang sering terserang Lernaea.
statement: Ikan maskoki adalah jenis ikan hias air tawar yang sering terserang parasit Lernaea.
text_en: Ikan maskoki adalah jenis ikan hias air tawar yang sering terserang parasit Lernaea.

quote: Hal tersebut mengaki-batkan para pembudidaya mengalami kerugian akibat dari serangan Lernaea.
statement: Serangan Lernaea pada ikan maskoki menyebabkan kerugian bagi pembudidaya.
text_en: Serangan Lernaea pada ikan maskoki menyebabkan kerugian bagi pembudidaya.

quote: Lernea caused irritation in skin with lesion.

text_zh: Lernaea引起皮肤刺激并伴有病变。
text_en: Lernaea causes skin irritation accompanied by lesions.

quote: Degrees of infestation Lernaea cyprinacea in three village categorization in low infestation.

quote: According to Pathak and Gopal (2009), water pollution caused by heavy metals increases the likelihood of bacterial resistance and infection in aquatic macrofauna, particularly fish populations and their consumers, representing a risk to public health.
statement: 根据Pathak和Gopal（2009），由重金属引起的水污染增加了水生大型动物（特别是鱼类种群及其消费者）发生细菌耐药性和感染的可能性，这对公共卫生构成风险。
text_zh: 根据Pathak和Gopal（2009），由重金属引起的水污染增加了水生大型动物（特别是鱼类种群及其消费者）发生细菌耐药性和感染的可能性，这对公共卫生构成风险。
text_en: According to Pathak and Gopal (2009), water pollution caused by heavy metals increases the likelihood of bacterial resistance and infection in large aquatic animals (particularly fish populations and their consumers), posing a risk to public health.

quote: 供試した個体の100%が生存並びに致死する限界日数は両方とも塩素量が6.4‰のときが最高で,それぞれ4日と10日であった｡
statement: 供試個体の全生存および全致死までの限界日数は、塩素量6.4‰時に最も長く、それぞれ4日と10日であった。
text_zh: 供試個体の全生存および全致死までの限界日数は、塩素量6.4‰時に最も長く、それぞれ4日と10日であった。
text_en: The limit days to total survival and total mortality of the test individuals were longest at a chlorine concentration of 6.4‰, being 4 days and 10 days, respectively.

quote: その他の濃度では限界日数は低下したが,塩素量が6.4‰以下より,以上の方がやや活発に遊泳する個体が多く観察され,両限界日数とも高い傾向をしめした｡
statement: 6.4‰以外の濃度では限界日数は低下したが、6.4‰以上の方が活発な遊泳が見られ、限界日数も高い傾向を示した。
text_zh: 6.4‰以外の濃度では限界日数は低下したが、6.4‰以上の方が活発な遊泳が見られ、限界日数も高い傾向を示した。
text_en: At concentrations other than 6.4‰, the limit days decreased, but at concentrations of 6.4‰ or higher, more active swimming was observed and limit days also showed a tendency to be higher.
outcome: 寄生虫の活動性と生存期間

quote: しかし,18.4‰の海水では約30分ですべての個体が不活発になり横転し,抵抗性はきわめて弱かった｡
statement: 18.4‰の海水では、約30分で全個体が不活発となり横転し、抵抗性は極めて低かった。
text_zh: 18.4‰の海水では、約30分で全個体が不活発となり横転し、抵抗性は極めて低かった。
text_en: In seawater at 18.4‰, all individuals became inactive and rolled over in about 30 minutes, with extremely low resistance.

quote: また,淡水では約2時間で不活発になり横転した｡
statement: 淡水では、約2時間で不活発となり横転した。
text_zh: 淡水では、約2時間で不活発となり横転した。
text_en: In freshwater, they became inactive and rolled over in about 2 hours.

quote: さらに塩素量が増加したために弱ったカワチブナに多数寄生し,大きな被害を生じたものと思われる｡
statement: さらに塩素量増加により弱ったカワチブナに多数寄生し、大きな被害が生じたと考えられる。
text_zh: さらに塩素量増加により弱ったカワチブナに多数寄生し、大きな被害が生じたと考えられる。
text_en: It is thought that many parasites attached to the weakened Carassius cuvieri due to increased chlorine levels, causing significant damage.
outcome: 宿主魚の健康状態と寄生被害

quote: カリグスは主にカワチブナの頭部,体表,鰭に寄生し,寄生されたカワチブナが多く斃死するなどの被害が発生した｡
statement: カリグスは主にカワチブナの頭部、体表、鰭に寄生し、寄生されたカワチブナが多く斃死するなどの被害が発生した。
text_zh: カリグスは主にカワチブナの頭部、体表、鰭に寄生し、寄生されたカワチブナが多く斃死するなどの被害が発生した。
text_en: Caligus mainly parasitizes the head, body surface, and fins of chub mackerel, causing damage such as mass mortality of parasitized chub mackerel.

quote: Indonesia merupakan salah satu negara yang beriklim tropis sehingga sering sekali ditemukan infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea pada ikan air tawar.
statement: Infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea pada ikan air tawar sering ditemukan di Indonesia karena iklim tropisnya.
text_en: Infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea pada ikan air tawar sering ditemukan di Indonesia karena iklim tropisnya.

quote: Hasil pengamatan pada penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa Lernaea cyprinacea menginfestasi ikan maskoki pada bagian sirip, mata dan tubuh.

text_en: Parasit Lernaea cyprinacea menginfestasi bagian sirip, mata, dan tubuh ikan maskoki.

quote: Motile aeromonad septicemia (MAS), which is caused by mesophilic A. hydrophila , has been a severe infectious disease in cultivated freshwater fish throughout China since 1989
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌引起的运动性气单胞菌败血症自1989年以来一直是中国养殖淡水鱼的一种严重传染病。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌引起的运动性气单胞菌败血症自1989年以来一直是中国养殖淡水鱼的一种严重传染病。
text_en: Motile Aeromonas septicemia caused by Aeromonas hydrophila has been a serious infectious disease in farmed freshwater fish in China since 1989.

quote: Penanganan dalam budidaya yang kurang baik dapat menye- babkan ikan mengalami stres, sehingga daya tahan tubuh menurun dan mudah terserang penyakit (Syawal dkk., 2008).
statement: Penanganan budidaya yang buruk menyebabkan stres pada ikan, menurunkan daya tahan tubuh, dan meningkatkan kerentanan terhadap penyakit.
text_en: Penanganan budidaya yang buruk menyebabkan stres pada ikan, menurunkan daya tahan tubuh, dan meningkatkan kerentanan terhadap penyakit.

quote: Parasit juga dapat mengakibatkan penurunan kualitas dan kuantitas ikan budidaya, pertumbuhan ikan terhambat bahkan dapat terjadi kematian, sehingga menyebabkan penurunan produksi dan kualitas ikan hias (Alifuddin dkk., 2002).
statement: Infestasi parasit menyebabkan penurunan kualitas dan kuantitas ikan, menghambat pertumbuhan, dan dapat menyebabkan kematian.
text_en: Infestasi parasit menyebabkan penurunan kualitas dan kuantitas ikan, menghambat pertumbuhan, dan dapat menyebabkan kematian.

statement: Identifikasi parasit pada ikan mas koki di beberapa desa di Tulungagung menemukan hanya satu spesies, yaitu Lernaea cyprinacea.
text_en: Identifikasi parasit pada ikan mas koki di beberapa desa di Tulungagung menemukan hanya satu spesies, yaitu Lernaea cyprinacea.

quote: Jumlah sampel ikan maskoki yang digunakan, dari 110 sampel ikan dari tiga desa sebanyak 47 ekor ikan maskoki yang positif terinfestasi Lernaea cyprinacea
statement: Dari 110 sampel ikan mas koki, 47 ekor terkonfirmasi positif terinfestasi Lernaea cyprinacea.
text_en: Dari 110 sampel ikan mas koki, 47 ekor terkonfirmasi positif terinfestasi Lernaea cyprinacea.

quote: Hasil dari pengelompokan menunjukkan bahwa 100% terinfestasi ringan.
statement: Semua ikan yang terinfestasi dalam studi ini dikategorikan memiliki derajat infestasi ringan.
text_en: Semua ikan yang terinfestasi dalam studi ini dikategorikan memiliki derajat infestasi ringan.

quote: Pengambilan sampel dilakukan sebanyak 10% dari populasi.
statement: Sampel diambil sebesar 10% dari total populasi ikan di setiap kolam.
text_en: Sampel diambil sebesar 10% dari total populasi ikan di setiap kolam.

quote: Sampel dimasukkan ke dalam kantong plastik dan diberi oksigen lalu dibawa ke Laboratorium Pendidikan Fakultas Perikanan dan Kelaut- an Universitas Airlangga, Surabaya.
statement: Ikan sampel dikemas dalam kantong plastik beroksigen untuk transportasi ke laboratorium.
text_en: Ikan sampel dikemas dalam kantong plastik beroksigen untuk transportasi ke laboratorium.

quote: Pengu- kuran kualitas air dilakukan langsung di lokasi pengambilan sampel pada saat pengambilan sampel berlangsung.
statement: Parameter kualitas air diukur secara in situ pada saat pengambilan sampel dilakukan.
text_en: Parameter kualitas air diukur secara in situ pada saat pengambilan sampel dilakukan.

quote: Penyakit dapat muncul di suatu perairan akibat ketidakseimbangan antara lingkungan, ikan, dan patogen.
statement: Penyakit dapat muncul di suatu perairan akibat ketidakseimbangan antara lingkungan, ikan, dan patogen.
text_en: Penyakit dapat muncul di suatu perairan akibat ketidakseimbangan antara lingkungan, ikan, dan patogen.

quote: Saran dari hasil penelitian ini adalah sebaiknya para pembudidaya ikan maskoki lebih melakukan pencegahan terhadap serangan Lernaea cyprinacea yang terdapat di kolam dengan menjaga kualitas air serta memilih ikan dengan kualitas yang baik agar serangan Lernaea cyprinacea dapat diminimalisir.
statement: Pencegahan terhadap serangan Lernaea cyprinacea dapat dilakukan dengan menjaga kualitas air serta memilih ikan dengan kualitas yang baik.
text_en: Pencegahan terhadap serangan Lernaea cyprinacea dapat dilakukan dengan menjaga kualitas air serta memilih ikan dengan kualitas yang baik.
intervention: Water quality upkeep and fish selection

quote: The fish were killed by severing the cervical spine
statement: 实验鱼通过切断颈椎的方式被处死。
text_zh: 实验鱼通过切断颈椎的方式被处死。
text_en: The experimental fish were euthanized by cervical dislocation.

quote: 本種の寄生による被害は,1973年8月末から10月末頃にかけて,主にカワチブナが,それも比較的大きい個体が多く発死するという形であらわれた｡
statement: Caligus orientalisの寄生により、主にカワチブナの大きい個体で多数の斃死が発生した。
text_en: Caligus orientalisの寄生により、主にカワチブナの大きい個体で多数の斃死が発生した。

quote: 特に湖東水域では,本種が寄生した数百尾のカワチブナがたびたび接岸し,不活発に遊泳しながらやがて横転して斃死した｡
statement: 湖東水域では、寄生したカワチブナが不活発な遊泳を示し、横転して斃死した。
text_zh: 湖東水域では、寄生したカワチブナが不活発な遊泳を示し、横転して斃死した。
text_en: In the eastern lake waters, crucian carp infected with sea lice showed inactive swimming, rolled over, and died.

quote: この頃西部の斐伊川河口附近で漁獲したカワチブナを観察すると,被害状況は東部水域のものに比較して軽微であった｡
statement: 西部の斐伊川河口付近で漁獲されたカワチブナでは、東部水域と比較して被害が軽微であった。
text_zh: 西部の斐伊川河口付近で漁獲されたカワチブナでは、東部水域と比較して被害が軽微であった。
text_en: In Carassius cuvieri caught near the mouth of the Hii River in the western area, damage was minor compared to that in eastern waters.

quote: カワチブナの被害魚が魚体重1kgくらいの大きい個体に多く発生したのは,これらが東部水域から湖心部の深層水域,即ち,特に塩素量が高かった水域に多く生息していたことによるためと考えられた｡
statement: 大きいカワチブナでの被害が多いのは、それらが塩素量の高い深層水域に生息していたためと推測された。
text_zh: 大きいカワチブナでの被害が多いのは、それらが塩素量の高い深層水域に生息していたためと推測された。
text_en: It was inferred that the greater damage in large Carassius cuvieri was because they inhabited deep water areas with high chlorine levels.

quote: カワチブナ被害魚の症状は大半が非常にやせていて,本種が寄生した部位には出血斑が認められるものもあった｡
statement: 被害魚は痩せ細っており、寄生部位に出血斑が見られた。
text_zh: 被害魚は痩せ細っており、寄生部位に出血斑が見られた。
text_en: The affected fish were emaciated, and hemorrhagic spots were observed at the parasitic sites.

quote: カワチブナに寄生していた本種の個体数は魚の大きさによって異なり,大きい個体(BW 1.0～1.1Kg)では1尾に平均462個体,小さい個体(BW 0.2～0.3Kg)では1尾に183個体が寄生していた｡
statement: カワチブナの寄生個体数は宿主の大きさに依存し、大きい個体ほど寄生数が多かった。
text_zh: カワチブナの寄生個体数は宿主の大きさに依存し、大きい個体ほど寄生数が多かった。
text_en: The number of parasites on crucian carp depended on the size of the host, with larger individuals having more parasites.

quote: また,体表に寄生していた個体に附着糸chalimus stage(IZAWA,1969)のあるものも観察された｡
statement: 体表寄生個体には附着糸を持つチャリムスステージの個体も観察された。
text_zh: 体表寄生個体には附着糸を持つチャリムスステージの個体も観察された。
text_en: Chalimus stage individuals with attachment threads were also observed among body-surface parasites.

quote: It was also shown that even the non-specific immune response is more effective in gynogenetic females when compared to sexual ones in the Japanese crucian carp (C. auratus), and, at the same time, that the prevalence of Metagonimus sp. (Trematoda), for which fish act as the second intermediate host, was higher in gynogenetic females than in sexual forms (17).
statement: 在日本鲫鱼中，雌核发育雌性的非特异性免疫反应比两性雌性更有效，但作为第二中间宿主的吸虫（Metagonimus sp.）在雌核发育雌性中的流行率高于两性形式。
text_zh: 在日本鲫鱼中，雌核发育雌性的非特异性免疫反应比两性雌性更有效，但作为第二中间宿主的吸虫（Metagonimus sp.）在雌核发育雌性中的流行率高于两性形式。
text_en: In Japanese crucian carp, the non-specific immune response of gynogenetic females is more effective than that of bisexual females, but the prevalence of the trematode (Metagonimus sp.), acting as a second intermediate host, is higher in gynogenetic females than in bisexual forms.
outcome: 免疫反应与寄生虫流行率

quote: A statistically significant difference was found in parasite abundance (t-test for unequal variance, t = 3.523; p = 0.003) and in intensity of infection (t = 3.255; p = 0.005) between sexual and gynogenetic gibel carp, with the gynogenetic form being more infected than the sexual one
statement: 与有性异育银鲫相比，雌核发育异育银鲫的寄生虫丰度和感染强度存在显著差异，且雌核发育个体感染更严重。
text_zh: 与有性异育银鲫相比，雌核发育异育银鲫的寄生虫丰度和感染强度存在显著差异，且雌核发育个体感染更严重。
text_en: Compared with sexual gynogenetic Carassius auratus gibelio, there are significant differences in parasite abundance and infection intensity between gynogenetic Carassius auratus gibelio, and the gynogenetic individuals have more severe infections.

quote: High parasite infection was found in gynogenetic fish when compared to genetically diverse sexuals.
statement: 与遗传多样性较高的有性生殖个体相比，雌核发育个体的寄生虫感染率更高。
text_zh: 与遗传多样性较高的有性生殖个体相比，雌核发育个体的寄生虫感染率更高。
text_en: Compared to sexually reproducing individuals with higher genetic diversity, gynogenetic individuals have a higher rate of parasite infection.

quote: Sebanyak 110 ekor ikan maskoki, 47 ekor ikan maskoki positif terinfestasi Lernaea cyprinacea sedangkan 63 ekor negatif terinfestasi Lernaea cyprinacea.
statement: Dari 110 ekor ikan maskoki yang diamati, 47 ekor terkonfirmasi positif terinfestasi parasit Lernaea cyprinacea dan 63 ekor negatif.
text_en: Dari 110 ekor ikan maskoki yang diamati, 47 ekor terkonfirmasi positif terinfestasi parasit Lernaea cyprinacea dan 63 ekor negatif.

text_en: Infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea pada sampel ikan dikategorikan sebagai infestasi ringan berdasarkan jumlah parasit yang ditemukan.

statement: Rendahnya jumlah parasit yang terdeteksi diduga disebabkan oleh tahap perkembangan parasit (copepodid) yang belum menetap, atau parasit yang sudah mati dan lepas dari inang.
text_en: Rendahnya jumlah parasit yang terdeteksi diduga disebabkan oleh tahap perkembangan parasit (copepodid) yang belum menetap, atau parasit yang sudah mati dan lepas dari inang.

quote: Pengukuran kualitas air dilakukan pada parameter suhu, DO dan amoniak.
statement: Parameter kualitas air yang diukur dalam studi ini adalah suhu, oksigen terlarut (DO), dan amoniak.
text_en: Parameter kualitas air yang diukur dalam studi ini adalah suhu, oksigen terlarut (DO), dan amoniak.

text_en: Di Desa Karang Rejo, suhu kolam tercatat 28-30°C, DO 6 mg/l, dan amoniak 0,5 mg/l.

quote: sedangkan untuk Desa Ploso Kandang suhu kolam berkisar 28-29°C, DO pada kolam 6 mg/l serta amoniak pada kolam 0,5 mg/l,
statement: Di Desa Ploso Kandang, suhu kolam tercatat 28-29°C, DO 6 mg/l, dan amoniak 0,5 mg/l.
text_en: Di Desa Ploso Kandang, suhu kolam tercatat 28-29°C, DO 6 mg/l, dan amoniak 0,5 mg/l.

quote: dan untuk Desa Wajak suhu kolam berkisar 30-31°C, DO pada kolam berkisar antara 6-8 mg/l serta amoniak pada kolam 0 mg/l.

statement: Lernaea cyprinacea menginfeksi ikan maskoki karena ikan tersebut merupakan anggota famili Cyprinidae yang menjadi inang parasit ini.
text_en: Lernaea cyprinacea menginfeksi ikan maskoki karena ikan tersebut merupakan anggota famili Cyprinidae yang menjadi inang parasit ini.

quote: Fish were fed with frozen adult artemia, the commercial dry pellet (www.Exothobby.cz), and flakes (Tetra Min) during the whole experiment.
statement: 实验期间，鱼被喂食冷冻成年丰年虫、商业干颗粒饲料和薄片饲料。
text_zh: 实验期间，鱼被喂食冷冻成年丰年虫、商业干颗粒饲料和薄片饲料。
text_en: During the experiment, fish were fed frozen adult brine shrimp, commercial dry pellets, and flake feed.

quote: Subsequently, the experimental fish were individually exposed to an infection dose of 200 cercariae for two hours at 20.5 - 21°C in 200 ml of dechlorinated water.
statement: 随后，实验鱼在20.5-21°C的200毫升去氯水中单独暴露于200条尾蚴的感染剂量两小时。
text_zh: 随后，实验鱼在20.5-21°C的200毫升去氯水中单独暴露于200条尾蚴的感染剂量两小时。
text_en: Subsequently, the experimental fish were individually exposed to an infection dose of 200 cercariae in 200 milliliters of dechlorinated water at 20.5-21°C for two hours.

quote: After exposure, fish were transported back to the aquaria with a comparable water temperature and kept for six weeks.
statement: 暴露后，鱼被运回水温相当的水族箱中并饲养六周。
text_zh: 暴露后，鱼被运回水温相当的水族箱中并饲养六周。
text_en: After exposure, the fish were transported back to aquaria with comparable water temperatures and reared for six weeks.

quote: In accordance with the Red Queen hypothesis, higher parasite load was found in clonal fish when compared to genetically diverse sexual fish.
statement: 与遗传多样的有性生殖鱼相比，克隆鱼的寄生虫负荷更高。
text_zh: 与遗传多样的有性生殖鱼相比，克隆鱼的寄生虫负荷更高。
text_en: Compared to genetically diverse sexually reproducing fish, cloned fish have a higher parasite load.

quote: Surprisingly, however, the majority of these genes showed opposite trends of regulation in gynogenetic and sexual gibel carp, which may potentially indicate the loss of capacity in clonally reproducing fish to induce an effective immune response.
statement: 大多数基因在雌核发育和有性生殖鲫鱼中表现出相反的调节趋势，这可能表明克隆繁殖鱼类诱导有效免疫反应的能力丧失。
text_zh: 大多数基因在雌核发育和有性生殖鲫鱼中表现出相反的调节趋势，这可能表明克隆繁殖鱼类诱导有效免疫反应的能力丧失。
text_en: Most genes showed opposite regulation trends in gynogenetic and sexually reproducing crucian carp, which may indicate a loss of the ability to induce effective immune responses in clonally reproduced fish.

quote: Metacercariae of Diplostomum eye flukes may damage the eye retina, which may lead to cataract of the lens (31).
statement: Diplostomum眼吸虫的囊蚴可能损伤鱼的眼视网膜，并可能导致晶状体白内障。
text_zh: Diplostomum眼吸虫的囊蚴可能损伤鱼的眼视网膜，并可能导致晶状体白内障。
text_en: Metacercariae of Diplostomum eye flukes may damage the fish's retinal retina and may cause lens cataracts.

quote: Apart from eye damage, a number of red patches and swelling can be observed on fins, and on body or eye areas in cases of heavy infection.
statement: 除眼部损伤外，在重度感染情况下，鳍部、身体或眼部区域可观察到红色斑块和肿胀。
text_zh: 除眼部损伤外，在重度感染情况下，鳍部、身体或眼部区域可观察到红色斑块和肿胀。
text_en: In addition to eye damage, red patches and swelling can be observed on the fins, body, or eye area in cases of severe infection.

quote: In some cases, a high number of diplostomulas can block the blood vessels of gills causing asphyxia, shock, and damage to the nervous system (32).
statement: 在某些情况下，大量的双盘吸虫幼虫可能阻塞鳃部血管，导致窒息、休克和神经系统损伤。
text_zh: 在某些情况下，大量的双盘吸虫幼虫可能阻塞鳃部血管，导致窒息、休克和神经系统损伤。
text_en: In some cases, a large number of Dichotomitrema larvae may block the gill blood vessels, leading to suffocation, shock, and neurological damage.
outcome: 呼吸功能与神经系统健康

quote: Pathological effects in fish heavily parasitized by lens-infecting Diplostomum metacercariae include stunted growth, abnormal feeding due to the loss of visual acuity, and abnormal vitals (33), as well as increased mortality (34).
statement: 被感染晶状体的Diplostomum囊蚴严重寄生的鱼类出现的病理效应包括生长迟缓、因视力丧失导致的摄食异常、生命体征异常以及死亡率增加。
text_zh: 被感染晶状体的Diplostomum囊蚴严重寄生的鱼类出现的病理效应包括生长迟缓、因视力丧失导致的摄食异常、生命体征异常以及死亡率增加。
text_en: Pathological effects observed in fish heavily parasitized by Diplostomum metacercariae infecting the lens include stunted growth, feeding abnormalities due to vision loss, abnormal vital signs, and increased mortality.
outcome: 生长性能、摄食行为与存活率

quote: Hasil pengukuran kualitas air menunjukkan suhu pada tiga desa berkisar antara 28-31°C, DO pada kolam berkisar antara 6-8 mg/l, amoniak dalam kolam berkisar antara 0-0,5 mg/l serta pH air 7.
statement: Parameter kualitas air di lokasi penelitian tercatat sebagai suhu 28-31°C, DO 6-8 mg/l, amoniak 0-0,5 mg/l, dan pH 7.
text_en: Parameter kualitas air di lokasi penelitian tercatat sebagai suhu 28-31°C, DO 6-8 mg/l, amoniak 0-0,5 mg/l, dan pH 7.

quote: Ditemukannya Lernaea cyprinacea pada penelitian ini karena Lernaea cyprinacea dapat hidup pada suhu 24-29°C dan pH air antara 5,6 - 9 (Shariff and Sommerville, 1986) dimana rentang suhu dan pH air tersebut sesuai dengan lokasi penelitian.
statement: Keberadaan Lernaea cyprinacea dikaitkan dengan kesesuaian suhu dan pH air di lokasi penelitian dengan kisaran toleransi hidup parasit tersebut.
text_en: Keberadaan Lernaea cyprinacea dikaitkan dengan kesesuaian suhu dan pH air di lokasi penelitian dengan kisaran toleransi hidup parasit tersebut.

quote: Hasil dari pengukuran kualitas air kolam budidaya tempat pengambilan sampel menunjukkan bahwa kualitas air dalam kolam budidaya tersebut masih dalam kondisi normal dan dapat ditoleransi oleh ikan maskoki.
statement: Kualitas air di kolam budidaya berada dalam kondisi normal dan dapat ditoleransi oleh ikan maskoki.
text_en: Kualitas air di kolam budidaya berada dalam kondisi normal dan dapat ditoleransi oleh ikan maskoki.

quote: Kondisi ini dapat menyebabkan pertumbuhan Lernaea cyprinacea berlangsung dalam waktu yang lebih lama, sehingga pada ikan maskoki masih ditemukan adanya infestasi Lernaea cyprinacea dalam jumlah yang sedi
statement: Kondisi kualitas air yang normal memungkinkan pertumbuhan Lernaea cyprinacea berlangsung lebih lama, sehingga infestasi tetap ditemukan pada ikan maskoki.
text_en: Kondisi kualitas air yang normal memungkinkan pertumbuhan Lernaea cyprinacea berlangsung lebih lama, sehingga infestasi tetap ditemukan pada ikan maskoki.
counterevidence: Kualitas air normal tidak mencegah infestasi

quote: A total of 12 sexual and 12 gynogenetic immunologically naïve specimens of Carassius gibelio obtained by artificial breeding were selected for experimental infection by Diplostomum pseudospathaceum
statement: 总共选择了12条有性生殖和12条雌核发育的免疫学上幼稚的银鲫标本，这些标本通过人工繁殖获得，用于进行假单叶双穴吸虫的实验感染。
text_zh: 总共选择了12条有性生殖和12条雌核发育的免疫学上幼稚的银鲫标本，这些标本通过人工繁殖获得，用于进行假单叶双穴吸虫的实验感染。
text_en: A total of 12 sexually reproducing and 12 gynogenetic immunologically naive Carassius auratus gibelio specimens, obtained through artificial breeding, were selected for experimental infection with Pseudodiplozoon monophyllum.
intervention: Artificial breeding of juveniles and experimental infection
intervention_record: 人工繁殖幼鱼并实验感染
outcome: 实验动物来源与健康状态

quote: Differences in terms of immune response and susceptibility to parasitic infections were found between the gynogenetic and sexual forms.
statement: 在免疫反应和对寄生虫感染的易感性方面，雌核发育和有性形式之间存在差异。
text_zh: 在免疫反应和对寄生虫感染的易感性方面，雌核发育和有性形式之间存在差异。
text_en: There are differences between gynogenetic and sexual forms in terms of immune response and susceptibility to parasite infections.
outcome: 免疫反应与疾病易感性

quote: A study on the variability of major histocompatibility complex (MHC) genes in parasite-infected gynogenetic and sexual gibel carp revealed that the most common MHC genotypes of the gynogenetic females suffered from high parasite abundance or high metazoan species richness (mostly referring to host-specific monogeneans of the genus Dactylogyrus) (19).
statement: 一项关于感染寄生虫的雌核发育和有性银鲫主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）基因变异性的研究表明，雌核发育雌性最常见的MHC基因型遭受高寄生虫丰度或高后生动物物种丰富度（主要指单殖吸虫属Dactylogyrus）。
text_zh: 一项关于感染寄生虫的雌核发育和有性银鲫主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）基因变异性的研究表明，雌核发育雌性最常见的MHC基因型遭受高寄生虫丰度或高后生动物物种丰富度（主要指单殖吸虫属Dactylogyrus）。
text_en: A study on the major histocompatibility complex (MHC) gene variability of gynogenetic and sexual Carassius gibelio infected with parasites showed that the most common MHC genotype in gynogenetic females suffered from high parasite abundance or high metazoan species richness (mainly referring to the genus Dactylogyrus).

quote: The role of the adipocytokine signaling pathway was found to play a significant role in high-salinity stress in spotted scat (Scatophagus argus), with upregulation of the following genes: g6pc1 , socs1 , socs3 , adipor2 , pck1 , and ppara in liver of fish treated in high salinity conditions (77).
statement: 在斑点鲳（Scatophagus argus）中，脂肪细胞因子信号通路在高盐应激中起重要作用，表现为高盐处理条件下肝脏中g6pc1、socs1、socs3、adipor2、pck1和ppara基因的上调。
text_zh: 在斑点鲳（Scatophagus argus）中，脂肪细胞因子信号通路在高盐应激中起重要作用，表现为高盐处理条件下肝脏中g6pc1、socs1、socs3、adipor2、pck1和ppara基因的上调。
text_en: In spotted scat (Scatophagus argus), the adipocytokine signaling pathway plays an important role in high-salt stress, manifested as the upregulation of g6pc1, socs1, socs3, adipor2, pck1 and ppara genes in the liver under high-salt treatment conditions.
outcome: 渗透压调节与应激反应

quote: The study by Šimková et al. (19) included analyses of the MHC profiles of gynogenetic and sexual gibel carp and revealed that gynogens with the most common MHC genotypes were more parasitized when compared to sexuals.
statement: Šimková等人（19）的研究发现，具有最常见MHC基因型的银鲫雌核生殖个体比有性生殖个体的寄生虫感染率更高。
text_zh: Šimková等人（19）的研究发现，具有最常见MHC基因型的银鲫雌核生殖个体比有性生殖个体的寄生虫感染率更高。
text_en: A study by Šimková et al. (19) found that gynogenetic female Carassius gibelio individuals with the most common MHC genotypes had higher parasite infection rates than sexual individuals.

quote: In contrast, the higher susceptibility of gynogenetic triploid females of Japanese crucian carp (Carassius auratus langsdorfii) when compared to sexual diploid females was shown even with respect to the trematode Metagonimus sp. from Japan (17)
statement: 相比之下，日本鲫鱼（Carassius auratus langsdorfii）的三倍体雌核生殖雌性比二倍体有性生殖雌性对来自日本的吸虫Metagonimus sp.表现出更高的易感性。
text_zh: 相比之下，日本鲫鱼（Carassius auratus langsdorfii）的三倍体雌核生殖雌性比二倍体有性生殖雌性对来自日本的吸虫Metagonimus sp.表现出更高的易感性。
text_en: In contrast, triploid gynogenetic females of Japanese crucian carp (Carassius auratus langsdorfii) showed higher susceptibility to the trematode Metagonimus sp. from Japan than diploid sexual females.

quote: The study of Hakoyama et al. (17) showed the lower baseline immune response in the gynogenetic form, suggesting the lower immune activity of the phagocytes (nonspecific immune reaction) potentially explaining higher trematode load.
statement: Hakoyama等人的研究表明，雌核发育形式的基线免疫反应较低，提示吞噬细胞（非特异性免疫反应）的免疫活性较低，这可能解释了较高的吸虫负荷。
text_zh: Hakoyama等人的研究表明，雌核发育形式的基线免疫反应较低，提示吞噬细胞（非特异性免疫反应）的免疫活性较低，这可能解释了较高的吸虫负荷。
text_en: Hakoyama et al. showed that gynogenetic forms had lower baseline immune responses, suggesting lower immune activity of phagocytes (non-specific immune response), which may explain the higher trematode load.
outcome: 免疫反应与寄生虫感染

quote: The down-regulated expression of so-called cell death related genes, including plk2 among others, and the up-regulated expression of inflammation related genes, including il6 among others, was shown in the hybrid grouper Epinephelus fuscoguttatus x Epinephelus lanceolatus after bacterial infection (71).
statement: 在杂交石斑鱼（Epinephelus fuscoguttatus x Epinephelus lanceolatus）细菌感染后，包括plk2在内的细胞死亡相关基因表达下调，包括il6在内的炎症相关基因表达上调。
text_zh: 在杂交石斑鱼（Epinephelus fuscoguttatus x Epinephelus lanceolatus）细菌感染后，包括plk2在内的细胞死亡相关基因表达下调，包括il6在内的炎症相关基因表达上调。
text_en: After bacterial infection in hybrid grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus x Epinephelus lanceolatus), the expression of cell death-related genes, including plk2, was downregulated, and the expression of inflammation-related genes, including il6, was upregulated.

population.species: hybrid grouper Epinephelus fuscoguttatus x Epinephelus lanceolatus

outcome: 细菌感染后的基因表达变化

quote: Thus, in our study, we performed the experiment using the same dose of metacercariae of D. pseudospathaceum per individual immune-naïve gibel carp and revealed that the parasite is more successful in reaching the target organ, i.e. the eye lens, in gynogenetic fish then in the sexuals.
statement: 因此，在我们的研究中，我们对每只免疫初发的银鲫使用了相同剂量的D. pseudospathaceum后囊蚴进行实验，结果发现该寄生虫在雌核发育鱼中比在有性生殖鱼中更成功地到达目标器官，即晶状体。
text_zh: 因此，在我们的研究中，我们对每只免疫初发的银鲫使用了相同剂量的D. pseudospathaceum后囊蚴进行实验，结果发现该寄生虫在雌核发育鱼中比在有性生殖鱼中更成功地到达目标器官，即晶状体。
text_en: Therefore, in our study, we used the same dose of D. pseudospathaceum metacercariae for each immunologically naive Carassius auratus gibelio, and found that this parasite reached the target organ, the lens, more successfully in gynogenetic fish than in sexually reproducing fish.

quote: This finding may indicate that gynogenetic fish are either more susceptible to free-living cercariae penetrating fish skin, or alternatively that both gynogenetic and sexual fish are susceptible to cercariae but that the immune response of sexuals is more effective in eliminating the parasite in the course of its migration to the eye lens.
statement: 这一发现可能表明雌核发育鱼对穿透皮肤的自由生活尾蚴更敏感，或者两种鱼都敏感但有性生殖鱼的免疫反应在寄生虫迁移至晶状体的过程中更有效地消除了寄生虫。
text_zh: 这一发现可能表明雌核发育鱼对穿透皮肤的自由生活尾蚴更敏感，或者两种鱼都敏感但有性生殖鱼的免疫反应在寄生虫迁移至晶状体的过程中更有效地消除了寄生虫。
text_en: This finding may indicate that gynogenetic fish are more susceptible to skin-penetrating free-living cercariae, or that both types of fish are susceptible but the immune response of sexually reproducing fish more effectively eliminates parasites during their migration to the lens.

quote: Concerning the enriched DEGs directly involved in host immunity when gibel carp is infected by D. pseudospathaceum , they belong to three KEGG pathways (the C-type lectin receptor signaling pathway, the intestinal immune network for IgA production, and the Toll-like receptor signaling pathway) assigned within the immune system of the organismal systems category.
statement: 当银鲫被D. pseudospathaceum感染时，直接参与宿主免疫的富集差异表达基因属于三个KEGG通路：C型凝集素受体信号通路、肠道IgA产生免疫网络和Toll样受体信号通路。
text_zh: 当银鲫被D. pseudospathaceum感染时，直接参与宿主免疫的富集差异表达基因属于三个KEGG通路：C型凝集素受体信号通路、肠道IgA产生免疫网络和Toll样受体信号通路。
text_en: When Carassius auratus gibelio is infected with D. pseudospathaceum, the enriched differentially expressed genes directly involved in host immunity belong to three KEGG pathways: C-type lectin receptor signaling pathway, intestinal IgA production immune network, and Toll-like receptor signaling pathway.

quote: Concerning fish, upregulation of the genes associated with apoptosis was also found in relation to high temperature stress (such as the casp and trail genes), suggesting functional hypoxia (89) or the downregulation of some genes in relation to viral infection [e.g. casp8 in the study of Xiang et al. (90)].
statement: 在高温胁迫下，鱼类中与细胞凋亡相关的基因（如casp和trail）表达上调，提示功能性缺氧；而在病毒感染中则观察到某些基因的下调。
text_zh: 在高温胁迫下，鱼类中与细胞凋亡相关的基因（如casp和trail）表达上调，提示功能性缺氧；而在病毒感染中则观察到某些基因的下调。
text_en: Under high temperature stress, genes related to apoptosis in fish (such as casp and trail) are upregulated, suggesting functional hypoxia; whereas downregulation of certain genes is observed during viral infection.

quote: In our study, we revealed the upregulation of cflar , also called c-flip (CASP8 and FADD-like apoptosis regulator), and tnfrsf1a (tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 1A-like) together with gadd45a in sexual gibel carp after D. pseudospathaceum infection, likely indicating the potential of sexuals to establish an immune reaction to parasite-induced stress, and/or, alternatively, the insufficient capacity of gynogenetic fish to establish an appropriate cell response to trematode infection.
statement: 本研究发现，在感染假双盘吸虫后，有性生殖的银鲫中cflar、tnfrsf1a和gadd45a基因表达上调，这可能表明有性个体具有建立针对寄生虫诱导应激的免疫反应的潜力，或者表明雌核发育鱼缺乏建立适当的细胞反应以应对吸虫感染的能力。
text_zh: 本研究发现，在感染假双盘吸虫后，有性生殖的银鲫中cflar、tnfrsf1a和gadd45a基因表达上调，这可能表明有性个体具有建立针对寄生虫诱导应激的免疫反应的潜力，或者表明雌核发育鱼缺乏建立适当的细胞反应以应对吸虫感染的能力。
text_en: This study found that after infection with Pseudodiplostomum, the expression of cflar, tnfrsf1a and gadd45a genes was upregulated in sexually reproducing silver crucian carp. This may indicate that sexual individuals have the potential to establish an immune response against parasite-induced stress, or it may indicate that gynogenetic fish lack the ability to establish an appropriate cellular response to fluke infection.
outcome: 免疫反应与寄生虫应激

quote: Our study clearly evidences that host genotype influences the parasite infection rate and suggests the disadvantage faced by clonally reproducing fish from the point of views of parasite infection and immunity response to parasite infection.
statement: 研究明确证明宿主基因型影响寄生虫感染率，并表明克隆繁殖鱼类在寄生虫感染和免疫反应方面处于劣势。
text_zh: 研究明确证明宿主基因型影响寄生虫感染率，并表明克隆繁殖鱼类在寄生虫感染和免疫反应方面处于劣势。
text_en: The study clearly demonstrates that host genotype affects parasite infection rates, and indicates that clonally reproduced fish are disadvantaged in terms of parasite infection and immune response.
outcome: 寄生虫感染与免疫反应

quote: Haase et al. (45) indicated that the complement system activated via different pathways is a central part of the fish response to D. pseudospathaceum .
statement: Haase等人指出，通过不同途径激活的补体系统是鱼类对D. pseudospathaceum反应的核心部分。
text_zh: Haase等人指出，通过不同途径激活的补体系统是鱼类对D. pseudospathaceum反应的核心部分。
text_en: Haase et al. pointed out that the complement system activated through different pathways is a core part of the fish response to D. pseudospathaceum.

population.species: fish (sticklebacks in cited work, general context)

quote: In our model applied to select DEGs having different effects in sexual and gynogenetic fish, the genes associated with the complement system were not significant; however, their differential expression across the whole sample of infected (by mixed genotypes of D. pseudospathaceum) and non-infected gibel carp was evidenced using model without reproduction mode effect (i.e. selecting the immunity-associated DEGs acting in the same direction in gynogenetic triploids and sexual diploids).
statement: 在应用于区分有性和雌核发育鱼类中差异表达基因（DEGs）的模型中，与补体系统相关的基因不显著；然而，在使用不包含生殖方式效应的模型时，证明了这些基因在混合基因型D. pseudospathaceum感染的和非感染的银鲫全样本中存在差异表达。
text_zh: 在应用于区分有性和雌核发育鱼类中差异表达基因（DEGs）的模型中，与补体系统相关的基因不显著；然而，在使用不包含生殖方式效应的模型时，证明了这些基因在混合基因型D. pseudospathaceum感染的和非感染的银鲫全样本中存在差异表达。
text_en: In the model applied to differentially expressed genes (DEGs) distinguishing sexual and gynogenetic fish, genes related to the complement system were not significant; however, when using a model that does not include the effect of reproductive mode, these genes were shown to be differentially expressed in all samples of Carassius gibelio infected with mixed-genotype D. pseudospathaceum and uninfected ones.
intervention_record: 混合基因型寄生虫感染
outcome: 补体系统相关基因表达
limitations: 在考虑生殖方式的模型中不显著，但在不考虑该效应的整体样本模型中显著
counterevidence: 在有性vs雌核发育对比模型中不显著

quote: Two genes – tlr5 and il6 , as two important markers of innate immunity - were involved in gibel carp immune response when fish were infected by D. pseudospathaceum
statement: tlr5和il6作为先天免疫的重要标志物，参与银鲫感染D. pseudospathaceum时的免疫反应。
text_zh: tlr5和il6作为先天免疫的重要标志物，参与银鲫感染D. pseudospathaceum时的免疫反应。
text_en: tlr5 and il6, as important markers of innate immunity, participate in the immune response during D. pseudospathaceum infection in gibel carp.
